players.product: BlueBird Block 2 direct-to-cell satellites (custom AST5000 ASIC) and MNO gateway equipment

quarterly_data.signal: AST 10-Q: the first Block 2 BlueBird satellite (BB6) was successfully deployed in February 2026; on April 19, 2026, during the New Glenn 3 mission, BB7 was placed into a lower than planned orbit by the launch vehicle's upper stage and was de-orbited; AST maintained launch insurance coverage for this launch.
